verificationProcedure: Record the evidence commit SHA externally in the fresh review or PR.
Run git cat-file -p <evidenceSha> and require its single parent to equal 31767959b5904afbab77ab5ee36f24da6d15b1c8.
For every productFiles entry, run git rev-parse 31767959b5904afbab77ab5ee36f24da6d15b1c8:<path> and compare the Git blob ID.
For every evidenceArtifacts entry, run git rev-parse <evidenceSha>:<path> and compare the Git blob ID.
Parse report.json and evidence-manifest.json from <evidenceSha>; do not infer evidence-head integrity from an omitted self hash.
reviewGate: HOLD_PENDING_FRESH_REVIEW. The evidence commit object is externally bound by the next reviewer or PR; this manifest does not claim integration completion.
